name: license
body: kalide's code is licensed under the Apache License 2.0: a repo-root `LICENSE` file carries the full Apache-2.0 text and applies to the repository EXCEPT the `brand/` directory (kalide's brand is all rights reserved — see brand-identity). It is separate from, and must not replace or alter, the vendored `internal/assets/reveal/LICENSE` (reveal.js's own MIT license, committed alongside the vendored runtime per embedded-assets). A repo-root `NOTICE` records that reveal.js is vendored under MIT at that path, states that `brand/` is excluded from the Apache-2.0 license, and states that "kalide" and the kalide logo are trademarks of Really Knows AI and are not licensed under Apache-2.0 (Apache-2.0 §6 withholds trademark rights; the logo artwork is copyrightable, so the exclusion is stated explicitly). `Formula/kalide.rb` carries `license "Apache-2.0"`. AC: repo-root `LICENSE` contains the Apache License 2.0 text; `internal/assets/reveal/LICENSE` is unchanged and still states reveal.js's MIT license; `NOTICE` names reveal.js/MIT, states the `brand/` exclusion and the Really Knows AI trademark statement citing §6; README.md has a license line stating the code is Apache-2.0 and `brand/` is excluded; `Formula/kalide.rb`'s `license` field reads "Apache-2.0".
